data.explanation: This is your official income tax assessment (Einkommensteuerbescheid) from Finanzamt Beispielau for the 2025 tax year. Based on your declared income, deductions and the wage tax already withheld, you are owed a refund of €539.00, which the tax office will transfer automatically to your account — no action needed for that part. If you disagree with how the assessment was calculated (for example the childcare costs), you may file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Beispielau; the app will show until when you can do this based on this letter's notification date. If you do nothing by then, the assessment becomes final. Consider professional tax advice if the figures seem wrong.

items.title: Decide whether to object to the tax assessment (Einspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the assessment, file an objection (Einspruch) with Finanzamt Beispielau in writing, electronically, or recorded in person, by the deadline shown.
items.consequence: If no objection is filed in time, the assessment becomes final (bestandskräftig).
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Beispielau ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.

items.title: Receive income tax refund
items.action: No action needed — Finanzamt Beispielau will transfer the refund automatically to the account on file.
items.quote: Das Guthaben von 539,00 € überweisen wir auf Ihr Konto DE14 5139 0000 0074 4022 18.
